build.command: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/Marquee.xcworkspace -scheme Marquee -configuration Debug -sdk appletvsimulator -derivedDataPath ios/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
build.productionCommand: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild archive -workspace ios/Marquee.xcworkspace -scheme Marquee -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=tvOS' -archivePath ios/build/Marquee.xcarchive ${VIBEVIEW_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY:+"CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=$VIBEVIEW_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY"} && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath ios/build/Marquee.xcarchive -exportPath ios/build -exportOptionsPlist "$VIBEVIEW_EXPORT_OPTIONS_PLIST"

build.command: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug -PreactNativeArchitectures=x86,x86_64
build.productionCommand: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
